name: convertr-scripts
description: Loaders internos da Convertr para as lojas (servidos via jsDelivr @main)

scripts.build: npm run build:cvt-user-data && npm run build:google-ads && npm run build:meta-ads && npm run build:ga4 && npm run build:merchant-reviews && npm run build:b2b-events
scripts.test: npm run test:cvt-user-data && npm run test:google-ads && npm run test:meta-ads && npm run test:ga4 && npm run test:merchant-reviews && npm run test:b2b-events
scripts.test:cvt-user-data: node src/cvt-user-data/cvt-user-data.test.js src/cvt-user-data/cvt-user-data-loader.js && node src/cvt-user-data/cvt-user-data.test.js cvt-user-data-loader.min.js
scripts.test:google-ads: node src/google-ads/google-ads-loader.test.js src/google-ads/google-ads-loader.js && node src/google-ads/google-ads-loader.test.js google-ads-loader.min.js
scripts.test:meta-ads: node src/meta-ads/meta-ads-loader.test.js src/meta-ads/meta-ads-loader.js && node src/meta-ads/meta-ads-loader.test.js meta-ads-loader.min.js
scripts.test:ga4: node src/ga4/ga4-loader.test.js src/ga4/ga4-loader.js && node src/ga4/ga4-loader.test.js ga4-loader.min.js
scripts.test:b2b-events: node src/b2b-events/b2b-events-loader.test.js src/b2b-events/b2b-events-loader.js && node src/b2b-events/b2b-events-loader.test.js b2b-events-loader.min.js
